description: This source file implements a plugin hook runner utility for a plugin-based architecture, providing functions to execute lifecycle hooks with error handling, prioritization, and support for async and sync handlers across various plugin lifecycle events including agent, message, tool, session, gateway, and install hooks.

methods.name: function getHooksForName<K extends PluginHookName>( getHooksForName
methods.description: Retrieves hooks for a specific hook name, sorted by priority (higher first).

methods.name: function getHooksForNameAndPlugin<K extends PluginHookName>( getHooksForNameAndPlugin
methods.description: Retrieves hooks for a specific hook name and plugin ID.

methods.name: export function createHookRunner(registry: PluginRegistry, options: HookRunnerOptions = {}) { createHookRunner
methods.description: Creates a hook runner object with functions to execute various plugin lifecycle hooks, supporting error handling, priority ordering, and async/sync execution logic.

methods.name: hasHooks
methods.description: Checks if any hooks are registered for a given hook name.

methods.name: getHookCount
methods.description: Returns the number of registered hooks for a given hook name.

methods.name: runBeforeModelResolve
methods.description: Executes 'before_model_resolve' hooks, allowing plugins to override provider/model before model resolution.

methods.name: runBeforePromptBuild
methods.description: Executes 'before_prompt_build' hooks for injecting context and system prompt before prompt submission.

methods.name: runBeforeAgentStart
methods.description: Legacy hook that combines model resolve and prompt build phases for agent start.

methods.name: runBeforeAgentReply
methods.description: Executes 'before_agent_reply' hooks to intercept messages and possibly provide synthetic replies.

methods.name: runAgentEnd
methods.description: Executes 'agent_end' hooks, runs in parallel.

methods.name: runLlmInput
methods.description: Executes 'llm_input' hooks to observe the input payload sent to the LLM, runs in parallel.

methods.name: runLlmOutput
methods.description: Executes 'llm_output' hooks to observe the output payload from the LLM, runs in parallel.

methods.name: runBeforeCompaction
methods.description: Executes 'before_compaction' hooks.

methods.name: runAfterCompaction
methods.description: Executes 'after_compaction' hooks.

methods.name: runBeforeReset
methods.description: Executes 'before_reset' hooks, fires when session resets happen.

methods.name: runInboundClaim
methods.description: Executes 'inbound_claim' hooks for claiming an inbound event.

methods.name: runInboundClaimForPlugin
methods.description: Executes inbound_claim hooks for a specific plugin.

methods.name: runInboundClaimForPluginOutcome
methods.description: Executes inbound_claim hooks for a plugin and returns the outcome details.

methods.name: runMessageReceived
methods.description: Executes 'message_received' hooks, runs in parallel.

methods.name: runBeforeDispatch
methods.description: Executes 'before_dispatch' hooks to inspect/handle messages, first to return handled=true wins.

methods.name: runMessageSending
methods.description: Executes 'message_sending' hooks for modifying/canceling outgoing messages, sequentially.

methods.name: runMessageSent
methods.description: Executes 'message_sent' hooks, runs in parallel.

methods.name: runBeforeToolCall
methods.description: Executes 'before_tool_call' hooks for plugin to modify or block tool calls, sequentially.

methods.name: runAfterToolCall
methods.description: Executes 'after_tool_call' hooks, runs in parallel.

methods.name: runToolResultPersist
methods.description: Executes 'tool_result_persist' hooks synchronously for processing tool results, priority-based.

methods.name: runBeforeMessageWrite
methods.description: Executes 'before_message_write' hooks synchronously before writing messages, capable of blocking or modifying message.

methods.name: runSessionStart
methods.description: Executes 'session_start' hooks, in parallel.

methods.name: runSessionEnd
methods.description: Executes 'session_end' hooks, in parallel.

methods.name: runSubagentSpawning
methods.description: Executes 'subagent_spawning' hooks sequentially.

methods.name: runSubagentDeliveryTarget
methods.description: Executes 'subagent_delivery_target' hooks sequentially.

methods.name: runSubagentSpawned
methods.description: Executes 'subagent_spawned' hooks, in parallel.

methods.name: runSubagentEnded
methods.description: Executes 'subagent_ended' hooks, in parallel.

methods.name: runGatewayStart
methods.description: Executes 'gateway_start' hooks, in parallel.

methods.name: runGatewayStop
methods.description: Executes 'gateway_stop' hooks, in parallel.

methods.name: runBeforeInstall
methods.description: Executes 'before_install' hooks for plugin installation, sequentially.
